m0-context.title: Load baseline context + validate synthesis hypothesis
m0-context.imperative: Read CREW_CONTEXT, GLOSSARY, handoff, all 4 spikes (m3/m7/m4/m8), scoreboard seam, braking_view, G2 portfolio result. Probe the synthesis hypothesis on the live scoreboard. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: context loaded; handoff complete; synthesis hypothesis probed (Bahrain reaches <=2-3 gap with tight braking soft-obs, Monaco ring_ok, Belgium not regressed)

m1-tv.title: TV-denoise kernel (edge-preserving IRLS) + L2 edge-preservation tests (TDD)
m1-tv.imperative: Productionize the edge-preserving TV/IRLS denoise as a pure function in decoupled_longitudinal.py. TDD: write edge-preservation + noise-removal tests first (red), then implement (green).

postconditions.statement: tv_denoise preserves a known step edge and removes noise; tests pass

m2-filter.title: 1D Kalman-RTS filter returning a_long AND sigma_a (honest covariance) + L2 positivity tests
m2-filter.imperative: Productionize the 1D Kalman-RTS smoother on [v,a] returning a_long and per-sample sigma_a from smoothed P[1,1]. TDD: covariance-positivity + degenerate-reduction tests first.

postconditions.statement: filter returns finite a_long and sigma_a>0 everywhere; tests pass

constraints: honest covariance first-class; units signed m/s^2 decel negative

m3-synthesis.title: Synthesis estimator + VariantFn + L1 synthetic-step recovery + L3 limit tests
m3-synthesis.imperative: Compose TV-denoise + 1D filter into the decoupled longitudinal estimator and a VariantFn (variant_synthesis) consuming CaseInputs. Add L1 synthetic sharp-decel recovery and L3 limit (sig->0 tracks raw; sig->inf reduces to speed-only) tests.

postconditions.statement: estimate_longitudinal + variant_synthesis present; L1 synthetic recovery within tol; L3 limits hold; tests pass

constraints: single canonical path; decision:two_cycle_external_anchor_design (TV of raw only)

m4-scoreboard.title: L4 scoreboard proof: synthesis passes Bahrain + Monaco + Belgium together
m4-scoreboard.imperative: Add a scoreboard-proof driver under scripts/ that runs run_scoreboard on the 3 cases for synthesis+gaussian+kind3, emits the proof table + dashboard plot to reports/physics/. Confirm both acceptance circuits pass without regressing Belgium.

postconditions.statement: scoreboard proof table emitted: Bahrain gap<=~3, Monaco ring_ok, Belgium not worse than kind3 by >0.5

m5-verify.title: Region tests + simplification limits + retire-assessment
m5-verify.imperative: Run full layer2 suite (no regressions) and simplification_limits on new files (clean). Write the clean_longitudinal_from_raw retire-assessment. Write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

postconditions.statement: layer2 suite green; simplification_limits clean on new files
